faq.title: ❓ Ngā Pātai Auau

q1.question: Me pēhea au e whakatangi ai i te puoro?
q1.answer: Whakamahia te `/play <song name or URL>` hei whakatangi puoro. Ka uru te bot ki tō hongere reo, ka tīmata ki te whakatangi.

q2.question: He aha te puoro e pōturi ai, e motu ai rānei?
q2.answer: I te nuinga o te wā, nā ngā raru whatunga tēnei. Whakamātauria te `/resetbitrate`, tirohia rānei te rohe o tō tūmau.

q3.question: Me pēhea au e waihanga ai i tētahi rārangi waiata?
q3.answer: Whakamahia te `/collections create <name>` hei waihanga kohinga. Kātahi ka whakamahi i te `/collections save <name>` hei tiaki i te rārangi tatari o nāianei.

q4.question: He aha ngā puna puoro e tautokona ana?
q4.answer: E tautokona ana a YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, me ngā URL tōtika.

q5.question: Me pēhea au e peke ai i tētahi waiata?
q5.answer: Whakamahia te `/skip` hei peke i te ara o nāianei, te `/skipto <number>` rānei hei peke ki tētahi ara motuhake.

q6.question: Me pēhea au e whakahohe ai i te aratau 24/7?
q6.answer: He āhuatanga utu nui te aratau 24/7. Whakamahia te `/premium` mō ētahi atu mōhiohio.

faq.footer: He āwhina anō e hiahiatia ana? Uru mai ki tō mātou tūmau tautoko mā /support
